rawContent: @McReynoldsJoe @EmilyYoffe Most of Al Franken's _accusers_ (victimhood not established) wouldn't talk to @JaneMayerNYer. Jane Mayer!? Should she "rethink" her course? She's been a #MeToo force!
@hartwellbrooks @rmayemsinger @SenGillibrand @cmclymer Yeah, award-winning investigative journalist and #MeToo hero Jane Mayer writes propaganda pieces. Yup.

#MeToo is hugely important.

Yet I can think of few better ways to feed backlash than:

1. Attack Jane Mayer's credibility, claiming she has an agenda in her reporting outside of fact-finding.

2. Suggest Cosby's allegations, and their treatment, are analogous to that of Franken.

@Quantum_Quench @BagLady20 @kate_ugh @MoiraDonegan I am a feminist and I'm certainly not happy with how it turned out. We lost him and we lost credibility at the same time. It was bad all around, and the efforts now, like the article here which has to cast Jane Mayer (!!!) as engaging in "backlash" to harm #MeToo shows how much.

@PigInZen67 @the_unitron @emigre80 “Either you believe in #metoo or not.”

Ever heard of false dichotomy? It’s a common logical fallacy. This is a great example of one.

@MichaelRMora @rbottoms @SER1897 Most accusers wouldn't speak to Jane Mayer, so she couldn't do much about that. Weird, no, that a champion journalist wrt #MeToo was not trusted by them? I mean, who better to stand up any solid allegation than Jane freakin' Mayer?

Unless, maybe, NOT a solid allegation?

@JohnMashey @Lightecojak @tesla1963 @the_unitron @annamerlan Heh. I was just mentioning that history while composing second part of my reply (before seeing this).

Yeah. She's not all that. Which is a shame, given I DO care about #MeToo, but these journos need to be diligent, not the other way around, or they are weakening it, not helping.

@phxazblue @RWPUSA @alfranken Franken was a target of RW before he ever ran for office. They loathe him. They tried everything they could when he was running, too. First time. Second time.

Only in the heat of #MeToo could claims be pumped and believed - with no proper investigation at all! - so very quickly.

@SerenaVW7 @Lynne_MediaLit @JRubinBlogger That does seem to be how it plays out.

I'm glad to be in the company of strong women who are NOT afraid to question (@JaneMayerNYer) or to express sincere regret (@SenDuckworth) or note the potential harms to #MeToo (@DebraKatz).
